$comment: Every figure this repository's documents state, and the derivation that re-computes it from
source. Read by claims.py, which is byte-identical across the three asset repositories while
this file is not — same arrangement as dialects.json and providers.json, for the same reason:
the engine is estate-wide and the content is this repository's.
A claim is `find`, a regular expression with EXACTLY ONE capture group, plus `derive`. The
expression must match exactly once in `document`. Zero matches fails — that is the failure
mode this kind of guard rots into, and a pattern that has stopped matching cannot be told
from a claim someone deleted. More than one match fails too: it means the figure is stated in
two places and only one of them is being checked.
THE TWO DEFECTS THIS FILE WAS WRITTEN AFTER. The section on the positive dialect said idea
drift rose from 2 of 15, when the three repositories' own scored artefacts sum to 1 — and it
said so in both game repositories because the paragraph had been copied between them. The
same copy carried '74 of them here' into aetherholm, where the figure is 92. A sentence
copied between repositories carries its numbers with it, and nothing was re-deriving them.
The pilot figures are sums over all three repositories' $pilot blocks, so a claim here is
checked against emberkin's, aetherholm's and micro-brand's scoring together. That is
deliberate: the row that was wrong was wrong in the SUM, not in any one repository's tally.

claims.find: \| assets needing at least one retry \| (\d+) of \d+ \|
\| assets needing at least one retry \| \d+ of (\d+) \|

claims.derive: pilot(idea not recognisable from the plan|qwen-image-2512)
claims.why: emberkin 1 of 9 + aetherholm 0 of 4 + micro-brand 0 of 2; both game files shipped 2

claims.find: drift rose from \d+ of 15 to (\d+) of 15
claims.derive: pilot(idea not recognisable from the plan|qwen-image-2512-positive)

claims.find: set is a\n(\d+)-asset pilot, not a whole set
"planned but never generated" — (\d+) of them here
claims.why: this repository's generated entries minus the entries the pilot set actually holds

claims.find: the Qwen brand set is (\d+) of \d+ today
the Qwen brand set is \d+ of (\d+) today
